The words 'Committed to Achievement', '#1 Best Public College', '#1 Top Hospital' are real HTML text (an h3 and paragraphs in the same section) that sits on top of the image, so they appear in the crop taken from the image's bounds; they are not part of the image. The model had the section text in the context and still attributed it to the image, so the cause is a model error (the overlaid text in the crop misled it). The live page has the same markup.
